answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement of 0.855, sequence agreement of 0.344, KL of 0.334, TV of 0.148 and Token-DiFR gap of 0.529 all sit at or just beyond the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908, 0.31-0.48, 0.197-0.339, 0.108-0.144, 0.28-0.52). They are well outside the fine-tuned range (KL up to 0.205, top-1 at least 0.900, TV up to 0.099) and the quantized range (KL up to 0.071). The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.1 is at the low end for system-prompted and fits fine-tuned too, so it does not separate them. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, but the size of the logit shift argues against it.
